title: 第十一章闭关修炼第十二章突破

第十一章闭关修炼
求点击！推荐！收藏！咖啡！小志在这里希望大家能顺手用鼠标点击一下！
灵魔是一个亡灵法师，由于在六阶初级的时候就产生了智慧，于是就开始组建起自己的势力！经过自己不断的努力终于，成为了这一片区域的掌控者！
现在魔灵已经是六阶巅峰的实力了，只要在进一步就会成为高级亡灵，到时候就是高级的亡灵法师了。只有成为高级亡灵才能在亡灵界立足，真正的掌控一方！
这么多年来，灵魔正是利用自己较早开启的智慧，不断的战胜比自己强大的敌人，才一步步的拥有了现在的势力！也正是灵魔自己的智慧，不断的躲过了一次次的危险！
所以灵魔对自己最满意也最骄傲的，并不是自己的实力和势力，而是自己的智慧！正是自己的智慧，最终自己成为了这一片区域的掌控者！但是最近灵魔去失算了……
那是一次偷袭，对方的队伍有五十多个亡灵，都是四阶巅峰以上的实力，灵魔已经很久没这样的对手了，要是能收服也是一股不小的势力！
本来灵魔看到它们的时候，觉得它们只是一个低级智慧的亡灵要队伍去别区域去闯荡。对付这种新手根本就是手到擒来，本来计划很顺利，利用诱饵把它们引入包围圈，然后自己就可以收服……
可是让灵魔没想到的是，它们的头领竟然只是个五阶高级骷髅战士，并不是自己认的那个青铜色的僵尸！最重要的是，自己一直被这个头领误导着，知道它们逃脱自己才知道，这中智慧绝对不容小视……
而且灵魔心头隐隐有一丝担心，“这一次放走的那两个亡灵绝对不是那么简单！这一次没能收服也没能彻底击杀，肯定是个后患，灵魔越想月越觉得心烦，自己引以为傲的智慧，竟然被耍了！而且还和对方结了仇留下了后患……”
话说陈林在逃出包围后，和小黑来到了一处偏僻的区域！在这里只有零星的几只亡灵，而且都是低级的！陈林选择这里就是因为这里很安全，陈林决定先稳定下来，在找机会报仇……
陈林现在对实力的渴望很强，陈林想变强！因为只有不断变强了才能够保命，才能够在亡灵界生存！这就是亡灵界的规则，所有的一切都是以强者位尊！
陈林知道自己的优势就是自己前世的记忆和智慧，还有就是参悟的《太平要术》的神通！除此之外和别的亡灵没什么区别！所以陈林决定要利用自己的智慧来组建自己新的势力！用自己参悟的神通使自己变得更强……
陈林开始反思，自己以前太过于依赖自己的智慧，利用自己的智慧战胜了很多比自己更强的对手！可是现在不同了，现在陈林要面对的对手同样也拥有智慧，陈林的优势就没有了！
那么陈林现在能依靠的就是，陈林拥有《太平要术》中的神通！自从参悟黄符领悟了神通后，陈林就没有刻意的去修炼过自己的神通，导致陈林现在的神魂决只是凡魂阶中级的水平！
神魂决绝对不只是提升灵魂强度那么简单，陈林觉得自己根本还没有施展出它的真正实力。所以陈林打算接下来的日子，要抓紧时间去修炼神魂决！
当然陈林还没有忘记自己的另一个神通――禁魂咒。这个强大的符咒契约跟西游记中的紧箍咒比只强不弱！在西游记中什么不会的唐僧利用紧箍咒，就能将法力通天的孙悟空管教的服服帖帖的！而陈林却只是用来收服几个低级的亡灵，根本没有发挥这个神通作用！
在想通之后，陈林决定要修炼自己的神魂决，起码要提升一个级别的修为才行！于是陈林就对小黑说，“小黑，我现在要闭关修炼一段时间，你帮我护卫一下！”
“主人放心，没有亡灵可以打扰你的！”小黑很郑重的回答道。小黑表现出来的智慧让陈林很放心！
“对了，你的那个黑色的能量也继续修炼下！这种能量很强，连我都觉得很危险！”陈林突然想起了小黑用的黑色的能量，于是交代小黑多修炼下！

小黑点头道“知道了主人，不过这种能量，我还不能很好控制……不过我会努力的！”
在交代了小黑后，陈林就开始修炼起了神魂决！神魂决是《太平要术》里最基础也是最高深的一门神通！陈林将自己的精神力又一次进入了自己灵魂中的黄.色光团中……
这是陈林第二次进入这个空间，在这个空间陈林还是感觉这个空间就是一个谜，一个充满了未知的迷！在这里到处都是玄奥的图案和文字，陈林只是参悟了一点就学会了那么多的神通！不过陈林没敢多去参悟，因为陈林知道现在自己的实力还不能参悟到有用的东西，而且贪多嚼不烂！
陈林知道自己就是因为还是在地球上的小资心态，造成了这次的失败！要是自己还是混吃等死的心态下去，在这个以强者为尊的亡灵界是必死无疑！
陈林在自己灵魂里的这个空间里，开始修炼起了神魂咒！因为陈林一直都是以吞噬别的灵魂为主，修炼起来反而很生涩！可是在这个奇特的空间里，一些生涩的和想不通的《太平要术》中的东西，在这里不知不觉的就想通了！神魂决修炼起来也是越来越顺利！
“看来这个空间绝对不只是参悟《太平要术》这么简单！”陈林感觉到了这个空间的神奇后这样想到。
不过陈林很快的集中精神修炼起了神魂决！不知不觉陈林在自己的灵魂进入了一种入定的状态，陈林也觉得奇怪自己要是平时要好长时间才能入定，现在却直接入定了……
在进入入定状态后，陈林就抛开了所有的再念，心与意合、意与神合进入了物我两忘的境界！在这个境界中陈林修炼的神魂决，要比平时快了十倍不止……
没过多久陈林的精神力又突然再度进入了一种更高深的层次，在这个状态下，陈林感觉到整个天地之间，突然无人无我，无欲无求，什么都不存在一般。似乎自己的灵魂就是天地就是一切……
陈林自己不知道自己现在的状态，就是前世地球上所有的修炼者梦寐以求的天人合一的修炼状态！在这个状态下修炼者能直接感悟天地，参悟世间的本源！修炼起来事半功倍，实力提升的速度加速的百倍不止！
这个时候在外面的小黑惊奇的发现，陈林的四周突然聚集起了浓郁的能量灵气，就仿佛被什么给牵动一般，直接聚集在陈林的四周……

Chapter 11: Retreat and Practice

The spirit demon is a necromancer. Since he developed wisdom at the beginning of the sixth level, he began to form his own power! After his continuous efforts, he finally became the master of this area!
The demon spirit is now at the peak of the sixth level. As long as it takes a further step, it will become a high-level undead, and then it will become a high-level necromancer. Only by becoming a high-level undead can you gain a foothold in the undead world and truly control it!
Over the years, the spirit demon has used his wisdom that he opened earlier to continuously defeat enemies that are stronger than him, and he has gradually gained his current power! It is also the spirit demon's own wisdom that keeps avoiding dangers again and again!
Therefore, what the spirit demon is most satisfied with and proud of is not his own strength and power, but his own wisdom! It was his own wisdom that finally made him the master of this area! But recently the spirit demon has miscalculated...
It was a sneak attack. There were more than fifty undead in the opponent's team, all with peak strength of level 4 or above. The spirit demons hadn't had such an opponent for a long time. If they could conquer it, they would be quite a force!
Originally, when the spirit demons saw them, they thought they were just undead with low-level intelligence and wanted the team to go to other areas. Dealing with this kind of novice is easy. The original plan was very smooth. Use bait to lure them into the encirclement, and then you can conquer them...
But what the spirit demons didn't expect was that their leader turned out to be just a fifth-level senior skeleton warrior, not the bronze zombie he recognized! The most important thing is that I have been misled by this leader. I didn’t know until they escaped. This wisdom must not be underestimated...
Moreover, there was a hint of worry in the spirit demon's heart, "The two undead souls let go this time are definitely not that simple! They failed to conquer and kill them completely this time, which must be a future trouble. The more the spirit demon thinks about it, the more upset it becomes. The wisdom that he is proud of has been fooled! Moreover, he has become a grudge against the other party, leaving behind trouble..."
It is said that after Chen Lin escaped from the siege, he and Xiao Hei came to a remote area! There are only a few sporadic undead here, and they are all low-level! Chen Lin chose this place because it was safe. Chen Lin decided to stabilize first and look for opportunities to take revenge...
Chen Lin has a strong desire for strength now. Chen Lin wants to become stronger! Because only by continuously becoming stronger can we save our lives and survive in the world of the dead! This is the rule of the undead world, everything is based on the strong!
Chen Lin knew that his advantage was the memory and wisdom of his previous life, as well as the magical power of "The Art of Taiping" that he had comprehended! Other than that, it’s no different from other undead! So Chen Lin decided to use his wisdom to form his own new force! Use your own magical powers to make yourself stronger...
Chen Lin began to reflect on the fact that he had relied too much on his own wisdom in the past and used his own wisdom to defeat many opponents who were stronger than him! But it's different now. The opponent Chen Lin faces now also has wisdom, and Chen Lin's advantage is gone!
So what Chen Lin can rely on now is that Chen Lin has the magical power in "The Art of Taiping"! Ever since he learned the magical power through studying the Yellow Talisman, Chen Lin has not deliberately practiced his magical power. As a result, Chen Lin's current Divine Soul Art is only at the intermediate level of the mortal soul level!
The Divine Soul Art is definitely not just about improving the strength of the soul. Chen Lin feels that he has not yet demonstrated its true strength. Therefore, Chen Lin plans to seize the time to practice the Soul Art in the coming days!
Of course, Chen Lin has not forgotten his other magical power - the soul-forbidden curse. This powerful talisman contract is as powerful as the tight spell in Journey to the West! What can Tang not know in Journey to the West?The monk can use the tightening spell to discipline the powerful Sun Wukong into obedience! But Chen Lin only used it to subdue a few low-level undead, and did not use this magical power at all!
After thinking about it, Chen Lin decided to practice his own Divine Soul Art, at least to improve his cultivation level by one level! So Chen Lin said to Xiao Hei, "Xiao Hei, I am going to practice in seclusion for a period of time. Please protect me!"
"Don't worry, Master, no undead can disturb you!" Xiao Hei replied solemnly. The wisdom shown by Xiao Hei made Chen Lin feel reassured!
"By the way, continue to practice your black energy! This energy is so strong that even I feel it is dangerous!" Chen Lin suddenly remembered the black energy used by Xiao Hei, so he told Xiao Hei to practice more!
Xiao Hei nodded and said, "I know Master, but I can't control this energy very well...but I will try my best!"
After explaining Xiao Hei, Chen Lin began to practice the Soul Art! Divine Soul Art is the most basic and profound magical power in "The Art of Taiping"! Chen Lin once again entered his spiritual power into the yellow light group in his soul...
This is the second time Chen Lin has entered this space. In this space, Chen Lin still feels that this space is a mystery, a mystery full of unknowns! There are mysterious patterns and words everywhere here. Chen Lin learned so many magical powers after just a little enlightenment! However, Chen Lin did not dare to study more, because Chen Lin knew that he was not strong enough to study useful things, and he was biting off more than he could chew!
Chen Lin knew that it was his petty bourgeois mentality on earth that caused this failure! If you still keep the mentality of just eating and waiting to die, you will definitely die in this world of the undead where the strong are respected!
Chen Lin began to practice the Soul Curse in this space in his soul! Because Chen Lin has always focused on devouring other souls, his practice was very awkward! But in this strange space, some things in "Taiping Yashu" that were unfamiliar and difficult to figure out were figured out here without even realizing it! The practice of Divine Soul Art is getting smoother and smoother!
"It seems that this space is definitely not as simple as meditating on "The Art of Taiping"!" Chen Lin thought after feeling the magic of this space.
However, Chen Lin quickly concentrated on practicing the Divine Soul Art! Unknowingly, Chen Lin entered a state of trance in his soul. Chen Lin also felt strange that it usually took him a long time to enter trance, but now he entered trance directly...
After entering the state of concentration, Chen Lin put aside all thoughts, and the heart and mind, the mind and the spirit merged into a state of forgetfulness of things and myself! In this realm, the Divine Soul Art practiced by Chen Lin is more than ten times faster than usual...
Not long after, Chen Lin's mental power suddenly entered a higher level again. In this state, Chen Lin felt that there was suddenly no one, no self, no desire, no desire, and nothing existed in the entire world. It seems that my soul is everything in heaven and earth...
Chen Lin himself doesn't know that his current state is the state of cultivation where all the cultivators on earth dreamed of in the previous life: the unity of heaven and man! In this state, cultivators can directly perceive the heaven and earth and understand the origin of the world! When you practice, you get twice the result with half the effort, and your strength increases more than a hundred times faster!
At this time, Xiao Hei who was outside was surprised to find that a strong energy aura suddenly gathered around Chen Lin, as if being affected by something, it gathered directly around Chen Lin...
